These educational amounts are fixed independently of source fund weights, prices and company fundamentals. They are not actual holdings, index weights or investment recommendations.
methodology.freshness: A captured example, not a live feed. Each company and metric retains its retrieval date, reporting period, source filings and calculation provenance. Refresh a local copy to request newer evidence.
